subject: Invitation to Sarah's Birthday Party
body: Dear friends, I am excited to invite you to Sarah's birthday party this Saturday at 7 PM. The party will be held at our backyard with music, games, and delicious food. Please RSVP by Thursday so we can make arrangements accordingly. We look forward to celebrating this special day with all of you! Feel free to bring a plus one. Looking forward to seeing you there! Best regards, Emily
